author: nosimo
title: A.N.D. Awareness
tagline: Nearby NPCs notice Advanced Nudity Detection flashes on the player and NPCs
description: A new character bio section is added from 0413_clothingcoverage.prompt which adds coverage or lack of coverage of AND keyworded items as well as exposure through flashing state under the equpment list.  The AND_Awareness SKSE plugin watches A.N.D.'s flashing factions on the player and nearby NPCs and posts one short narration per allowed flash (curtains slipping, sheer garments turning see-through). Chance, cooldowns, which actors, which flash types and the narration text are all on this plugin's Settings page. Narration only states what the garment did; the clothing coverage prompt carries the resulting exposure. Also raises the SKSE mod event SN_ANDFlash (strArg = flash type, numArg = 1 start / 0 end, sender = actor) for other mods.
